title: hydrangea villosa var. velutina
intro: Hydrangea villosa var. velutina, commonly known as Mophead Hydrangea or Velvety Hydrangea, is a plant species native to China and Japan, characterized by its large, round clusters of pink or purple flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, improve digestive health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea villosa var. velutina include its ability to reduce fever, relieve headaches, and soothe skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of the plant include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
